descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Grandma Ghost' Rare Ghost Japanese Maple Tree Zone 5-9 The leaf on 'Grandma Ghost' is elegant, yet complex, in its beauty. 'Grandma Ghost' leafs out with a bright creamy foliage with deep green reticulated veins in the early spring. This member of the Ghost series of Japanese maples is a maple that will grab attention in the garden. 'Grandma Ghost' can reach 8-10 ft in height and width with age. Fall color on 'Grandma Ghost' ranges from bright oranges to bright crimson reds. For best color and longest display of reticulated variegation, give 'Grandma Ghost' protection from the hot afternoon sun. This will allow 'Grandma Ghost' to shine and brighten those darker shady spots in the garden.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Grandma Ghost' 稀有 Ghost 系列日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Grandma Ghost' 的叶片优雅而富于变化，观赏性很高。早春展叶时，叶色呈明亮的乳白色，带有深绿色网脉。这一 Ghost 系列日本枫成员在花园中极具吸引力。随着树龄增长，'Grandma Ghost' 的高度和冠幅都可达 8-10 英尺。秋色从鲜亮橙色到明亮的深红色不等。若要获得最佳叶色以及最长时间的网脉斑纹观赏期，建议为 'Grandma Ghost' 避开炎热的午后强光。这样可以让它在花园较阴的区域中更加出彩、提亮环境。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多。我们建议您尽快购买心仪的日本枫，因为某些品种常常很快售罄。
